nodes.title: SG-1.3 Rebuild GameLayout with Tailwind classes and the UI store
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx uses the legacy classes .game-layout, .scene-area and .story-panel from src/styles.css, plus a local useState drawer flag, although useUiStore already exposes drawerOpen and toggleDrawer. Desired behavior: on desktop the viewport shows an 80/20 game/story split with no page scroll or horizontal overflow. On mobile the story panel becomes a bottom drawer and the game controls stay reachable. Expected result: the legacy layout CSS is gone. Why: this is the responsive shell the StoryForge redesign requires.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a viewport of at least 768px, when GameLayout renders, then the layout is a full-height grid with columns 4fr/1fr, the root has overflow-hidden, and the story aside scrolls on its own.
- Given a viewport below 768px, when the Story toggle is clicked, then the aside moves from closed to open and the scene and its controls remain mounted and reachable.
- Given src/styles.css, when it is read, then it contains no .game-layout, .story-panel or .scene-area rules and no @media (max-width: 768px) block.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout.tsx Tailwind rebuild
- In scope: drawer state from useUiStore
- In scope: removal of legacy layout CSS from styles.css
- In scope: updating tests that assert the legacy classes
- Out of scope: Phaser integration
- Out of scope: HeaderOverlay
- Out of scope: StoryPanel content
- Out of scope: ContributionSheet restyling
- Preserve: GameLayout props scene and story
- Preserve: Story toggle button named 'Story' with aria-expanded
- Preserve: StoryPanel root class story-content
- Preserve: the .contribution-sheet CSS


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind utility classes (md breakpoint = 768px)
- Zustand useUiStore for drawer state
- Button, Lucide ChevronUp and motion.aside stay in use


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are implemented and verified by unit tests


## Non-functional requirements
- No horizontal overflow at any width


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · GameLayout renders the 80/20 desktop split with Tailwind and no page scroll
nodes.body:
Context: the desktop split is defined in legacy CSS (grid-template-columns 4fr 1fr, min-height 100vh). Desired behavior: GameLayout expresses it with Tailwind utilities, uses h-screen and overflow-hidden, and gives the story aside its own overflow-y-auto. Expected result: no page scroll or horizontal overflow on desktop. Why: the layout keeps the game dominant.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given GameLayout rendered, when its root element is inspected, then its classes include grid, h-screen, w-full, overflow-hidden and md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr].
- Given GameLayout rendered, when the aside is inspected, then its classes include overflow-y-auto and md:h-screen, and the scene main includes min-w-0.
- Given the stylesheet, when html, body and #root are read, then they have height 100% and overflow hidden.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout root, main and aside classes
- In scope: html/body/#root overflow rules in styles.css
- Out of scope: mobile drawer behavior
- Preserve: scene and story slots


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind utilities only for layout


## Definition of done
- Desktop classes implemented


## Non-functional requirements
- No horizontal overflow


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Story panel is a store-driven mobile bottom drawer and legacy layout CSS is removed
nodes.body:
Context: the drawer flag is local useState and the mobile positioning is in a legacy media query. Desired behavior: GameLayout reads drawerOpen and toggleDrawer from useUiStore, positions the aside as a fixed bottom drawer below md via Tailwind, and keeps scene controls reachable by reserving space for the drawer handle. The legacy layout rules are deleted. Why: the single store owns UI state and the legacy CSS is dead.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given useUiStore drawerOpen false, when GameLayout renders, then the Story button has aria-expanded false and the aside has data-state closed.
- Given the Story button clicked, when the store changes, then useUiStore.getState().drawerOpen is true, aria-expanded is true and the aside has data-state open; a second click returns it to false.
- Given the scene slot, when the drawer is closed or open, then the scene content remains in the document and the scene main has bottom padding below md (pb-12) so controls are not covered.
- Given src/styles.css, when read, then no .game-layout, .story-panel, .scene-area or max-width media query remains while .contribution-sheet rules remain.


## Scope
- In scope: useUiStore wiring in GameLayout
- In scope: mobile drawer Tailwind classes
- In scope: deleting legacy rules in styles.css
- Out of scope: desktop grid classes
- Preserve: Story button label and aria-expanded
- Preserve: uiStore API


## Technical constraints
- Do not change uiStore.ts
- Toggle button hidden at md and up


## Dependencies
- REQ-1


## Definition of done
- Drawer is store-driven and legacy CSS removed


## Non-functional requirements
- Drawer transition is smooth


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Apply Tailwind desktop layout classes and overflow rules
nodes.body:
Replace the legacy class names on GameLayout's root, main and aside with Tailwind utilities for the 80/20 split and independent story scrolling, and add the overflow rules for html, body and #root to styles.css.

## Acceptance criteria
- GameLayout root has grid h-screen w-full overflow-hidden grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[4fr_1fr].
- The aside has overflow-y-auto and md:h-screen; the main has min-w-0.
- styles.css sets html, body and #root to height 100% and overflow hidden.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout.tsx
- In scope: styles.css
- Out of scope: tests
- Preserve: props and Story button


## Technical constraints
- Tailwind utilities
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx`
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/styles.css`


## Dependencies
- REQ-1


## Definition of done
- Classes applied; build type-checks


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Drive the mobile drawer from useUiStore and delete legacy layout CSS
nodes.body:
Replace the local useState drawer in GameLayout with useUiStore selectors, style the aside as a fixed bottom drawer below md with data-state, hide the toggle at md and up, pad the scene for the handle, and delete the .game-layout, .story-panel and media-query rules from styles.css.

## Acceptance criteria
- GameLayout reads drawerOpen and toggleDrawer from useUiStore and has no useState.
- The aside carries data-state open/closed and translate classes; the scene main has pb-12 md:pb-0.
- styles.css no longer has the legacy rules; .contribution-sheet rules remain.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout.tsx
- In scope: styles.css
- Out of scope: uiStore.ts
- Out of scope: tests
- Preserve: Story button name and aria-expanded
- Preserve: contribution-sheet CSS


## Technical constraints
- Keep Button, ChevronUp, motion.aside
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/components/GameLayout.tsx`
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/styles.css`


## Dependencies
- ACT-1


## Definition of done
- Store-driven drawer; legacy CSS gone


## Clarifying questions
- None
